name: Paradise Falls (Cheshunt)
bio_draft: Waterfall in Alpine National Park, 31 m high and reached by a viewing platform.

name: Lake William Hovell
bio_draft: Lake near Cheshunt with swimming, paddling and picnic areas.

name: Dartmouth Dam
bio_draft: Large dam on the Mitta Mitta River with a lookout and boating.

name: Australian Alps Walking Track
bio_draft: Long-distance walking track linking the Australian Alps, with sections through the High Country.

name: Murray to the Mountains Rail Trail
bio_draft: Rail trail for cycling and walking from Wodonga to Bright and Wangaratta.

name: Omeo
bio_draft: Historic high country town on the Omeo Highway, a gateway to the southern Victorian Alps.
